id: title:Gilbert09:retry nerdgraph s generic nrdb error instead of failing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Adds warehouse ingestion reliability by treating a specific New Relic backend error ('There was an NRDB error') as a transient, retryable failure rather than a permanent ingestion failure.
review.reason: Score 1 assigned. The change is a narrow, localized maintenance improvement: it adds a specific error message string and its corresponding test assertion to the warehouse ingestion retryability detection. This does not demonstrate broader systemic capability or unverified benefit, but it does establish a bounded correctness improvement for warehouse-backed queries.
review.uncertainty: The actual benefit depends on the frequency and recoverability of this specific error in production, which is not demonstrated by the code alone. No other tier-3 systemic or tier-2 broader capability evidence is present.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.
